dedupe_keys.name: lta datamall singapore land transport data and apis

description: DataMall is the Land Transport Authority of Singapore's portal for land transport data. Its dynamic datasets are grouped as public transport, traffic, active mobility, geospatial and electric vehicle charging. They include real-time bus arrival with estimated location and load, bus routes, services and stops, GTFS Realtime train service alerts and lift maintenance in MRT stations; approved road works, estimated expressway travel times, faulty traffic lights, flood alerts from PUB and car park availability; bicycle parking; whole-island geospatial layers as shapefiles updated quarterly; and EV charging points with availability. Coverage is national for Singapore. Access: APIs after requesting an account key through a form, accepting the Singapore Open Data Licence and the Terms of Service for API and SDK; an API user guide is provided as PDF. Caveats: most feeds are real-time snapshots, so history must be collected by the user, and the terms-of-use page linked from the site returned not found. The data support network flow and capacity models of buses and roads, flood exposure of the road network and service disruption analysis. They complement the GTFS specification and the Mobility Database catalogued here.
